up: Return all IC50 activity data for CHEMBL3716726 and all of its salt forms against target CHEMBL375. The output must include the compound's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, activity ID, assay description, standard value, standard units, document year, PubMed ID, and DOI. Identify all salt forms by joining the molecule_hierarchy table to find records where the parent_molregno corresponds to CHEMBL3716726.
sql: WITH target_assays AS (SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE tid = (SELECT tid FROM target_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL375')), compound_set AS (SELECT molregno FROM molecule_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3716726' UNION SELECT mh.molregno FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = md.molregno WHERE md.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3716726') SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.activity_id, ass.description AS assay_description, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, d.year AS document_year, d.pubmed_id, d.doi FROM activities a JOIN target_assays ta ON a.assay_id = ta.assay_id JOIN compound_set cs2 ON a.molregno = cs2.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_relation IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
